question: Do the frozen R9 clinical primary/supplementary observations correctly distinguish authenticated EMC enrolment, eligibility, generic diagnoses, aggregate trial outcomes and linked individual conditions; and could any survive as a useful new contribution?
approach: Independent cached-file verification of all21 owner freeze bindings, source eligibility excerpts/rosters, reported eligible EMC conditions, access/portability and scientific value. Verify candidate observations against original JATS and machine-readable supplements without new downloads or graphical inspection.
strongest_alternative: A reported result is true but already published, reflects pooled non-EMC patients, is only permitted eligibility or has no patient/lesion/time/exposure linkage; recovering a source detail does not supply a new inference.
defeat: Any unsupported identity transfer, omitted accessible eligible condition, aggregate-to-individual inference, numerical outcome without linked dosing/dates/lesions, unresolved public suitable data or source/value mismatch prevents promotion.
bound: Twelve minutes after exact owner freeze receipt, one focused correction batch; own additive review only, no cross-lane edits. Quiet file/API only, no UI/browser/screenshots/headless/image inspection before14:00UTC; no duplicates/private/restricted platform bypass/spend/GPU/outreach/publication/PR. Minimum10GiB free remains.
expected_output: Small source/hash-bound review with plain-language question, approach, finding, strongest limits and concrete correction if needed.
